title: The Gate in the Mist
description: An unscored Mandarin rehearsal: a guarded portal, a choice, and a second chance.
sources: Original fictional fantasy scene. Background reused from the approved Learning is Fun manga-v1 rift illustration.

Guide.name: 岚 · Lan
Guide.provenance: Original fictional fantasy guide, shared polished SVG builder.

Guardian.name: 守门人 · Gatekeeper
Guardian.provenance: Original fictional gatekeeper, shared polished SVG builder.

别怕。我和你一起走。.english: Do not be afraid. I will go with you.
别怕。我和你一起走。.pinyin: bié pà 。 wǒ hé nǐ yì qǐ zǒu 。

等一下！你们要去哪里？.pinyin: děng yí xià ！ nǐ men yào qù nǎ lǐ ？

你先听了我说的话。现在，我也听你说。.english: You listened to what I had to say. Now I will listen to you too.
你先听了我说的话。现在，我也听你说。.pinyin: nǐ xiān tīng le wǒ shuō de huà 。 xiàn zài ， wǒ yě tīng nǐ shuō 。

下次先说话，好吗？.english: Next time, talk first, all right?
下次先说话，好吗？.pinyin: xià cì xiān shuō huà ， hǎo ma ？

script:
story 2
variable listened = false hidden
scene rift
beat reassurance Guide Guardian "Mist closes around the gate. Lan steps beside me; its keeper watches our hands."
Guide [determined, reassure]: 别怕。我和你一起走。
Guardian [skeptical, question]: 等一下！你们要去哪里？
choice approach
option listen "请先听我说。" -> listen ; listened = true
option rush "I try to slip past the keeper." -> rush
label listen
camera medium Guide
Guide [pleading]: 我们想回家。
camera close Guardian
Guardian [curious]: 好，我听你说。
goto join
label rush
show Guide determined left
show Guardian angry right
act Guardian attack-blocked Guide "The keeper lunges. Lan blocks, and both step back. Nobody is hurt."
Guide [shocked]: 小心！
goto join
label join
beat quiet-aftermath Guide Guardian "The gate remains shut. For a moment, the mist is the only thing moving."
if listened == true -> heard else repair
label heard
Guardian [relieved]: 你先听了我说的话。现在，我也听你说。
goto farewell
label repair
Guardian [worried]: 下次先说话，好吗？
goto farewell
label farewell
beat reconciliation Guide Guardian "The keeper steps aside. Lan waits for me before crossing the threshold."
Guide [happy]: 谢谢你。
end
